name: gx-openclaw-plugin-demo
description: A before_tool_call plugin that puts an agent's filesystem writes through the gx membrane, so that a write can be refused before it lands and taken back after it does.
//: The demo runs the .ts sources directly on Node's own type stripping: no build, no node_modules. `typecheck` is the optional stricter pass and is the only script that needs typescript and @types/node installed.
